fusions.name: Bring to Bay
fusions.desc: Throws your shield at the first enemy in its path, dealing 11 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Flush the Covert
fusions.desc: Sweeps your shield through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 8 damage to everything in it. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Stalking Cover
fusions.desc: Veils you behind your shield for 5 seconds: enemies notice you far later, you move 15% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Quarry at Bay
fusions.desc: You deal 10% more damage to enemies carrying your afflictions. Your armour is 5% higher.
